HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
